Attach self-attested copies of educational records, caste and residence certificate, registration certificate and experience certificate.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Chief Medical Officer, Budaun Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Chief Medical Officer, Budaun Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 30 vacancies: 1 Medical Officer (MBBS) - Telemedicine/Teli Consultation HUB, District Hospital Budaun, 5 General Physician, 1 MBBS Lady Medical Officer, 13 EMO, 6 Medical Officer (MBBS) - NUHM-PM-ABHIM UAAM, 4 Medical Officer (MBBS) - NUHM-15-FC U-AAM.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Chief Medical Officer, Budaun Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed format on https://budaun.nic.in/ (also printed as page 3 of this notice)) and send it to Office of the Chief Medical Officer, Budaun, by registered post only, to reach by 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 65 years (as on date of publication of the advertisement).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 1,00,000 for Medical Officer (MBBS) - Telemedicine/Teli Consultation HUB, District Hospital Budaun, Rs. 1,00,000 for General Physician, Rs. 1,00,000 for MBBS Lady Medical Officer, Rs. 1,00,000 for EMO, Rs. 80,000 + Rs 20,000 P.M. (PBI) for Medical Officer (MBBS) - NUHM-PM-ABHIM UAAM.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: M.B.B.S. degree from an MCI-recognised institution with registration from the State/GoI Council; MD (Medicine)/MBBS or equivalent with at least 1 year of hospital experience for General Physician. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Registration with the State/GoI Medical Council is required.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates older than 65 years on the date of publication of the advertisement.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview (information sent to candidates separately by call letter). Information about the interview for all posts will be sent separately by call letter. Reservation policy of the Uttar Pradesh Government will be followed.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Posts are on fixed honorarium under contract terms; no claim to regularisation. Appointment valid for the financial year; may be extended after Government of India approval. Contract may be ended with one month's notice or one month's amount if any adverse fact is found.
